categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in telecommunications, including mobile voice and data services, fixed-line communications, and new economy digital services such as OTT video streaming, e-commerce, and digital security. It also serves enterprise customers with integrated ICT solutions including cloud services, cybersecurity, IoT applications, and 5G private networks. Additionally, the company is involved in telecommunications equipment manufacturing, energy technology services, and media production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced 5G network technology, AI, big data analytics, IoT, and cloud computing to deliver its services. It employs AI-driven network optimization, 5G standalone core network deployment, and virtualized network infrastructure. The company also develops proprietary digital platforms such as AI-powered OTT streaming and e-commerce systems, and integrates Microsoft cloud solutions for enterprise digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves both individual consumers and enterprise clients. Individual customers use mobile and fixed-line communication services, digital entertainment, and e-commerce platforms. Enterprise customers span various industries and government sectors, requiring customized ICT integration, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, and smart city solutions. The company’s market is primarily Taiwan, including urban and remote areas, with some international roaming and overseas service extensions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, covering all regions including remote islands and mountainous areas. It also provides international roaming services and has strategic partnerships in the Asia-Pacific region. Its subsidiaries and investments extend to Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, China, and other locations supporting cloud and ICT services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream as a telecommunications service provider to end-users and enterprises. It also has upstream and midstream involvement through telecommunications equipment assembly, network infrastructure deployment, and technology development. It integrates supply chain management for network equipment and digital service platforms, maintaining strategic supplier relationships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating 5G network expansion and adoption, integrating AI and big data for service innovation, and expanding new economy digital services. The company focuses on sustainable development with green ICT solutions, energy management, and carbon reduction initiatives. R&D efforts target 5G advanced features, network virtualization, AI-enhanced customer experience, and smart city applications, alongside continuous digital transformation for enterprise clients.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through telecommunications service subscriptions including mobile voice/data and fixed-line services. Additional income streams include digital content subscriptions, e-commerce transactions, ICT integration services, cloud and cybersecurity solutions, and enterprise digital transformation projects. The company also earns from equipment sales, leasing, and value-added services such as insurance and digital tools.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the top three telecom operators in Taiwan, competing primarily with Chunghwa Telecom and Taiwan Mobile. It holds a leading position in 5G penetration and ARPU among the three. The company differentiates itself through superior network quality, innovative digital services, and strong enterprise ICT solutions. It maintains competitive advantages in spectrum resources, network coverage, and strategic partnerships with global technology providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues exceeding NT$104.6 billion in 2024, marking an 11.7% year-over-year growth and a historical high. EBITDA and net profit also reached near 18-year highs with double-digit growth rates. The company maintains a strong financial structure with stable cash flows, a market capitalization exceeding NT$320 billion, and consistent dividend policies. It has demonstrated resilience and growth post-merger with Asia Pacific Telecom.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, secure, and environmentally friendly network services with extensive 5G coverage and advanced AI integration. It offers personalized digital experiences through proprietary platforms like friDay OTT and e-commerce, combined with comprehensive enterprise ICT solutions leveraging cloud, AI, and IoT. Its commitment to sustainability, innovation, and customer-centric service positions it as a trusted leader in Taiwan’s telecommunications and digital transformation landscape.
